title: Release-gate evidence
description: Records every required external release-gate check bound to its exact command, runner identity, exit code, and tested source commit/tree/archive identity. Output contract owned by Todo 35's harness; final qualifying emission owned by Todo 37. Todo 1 shipped this as a restrictive stub; Todo 35 froze it by adding the two normative facts a per-check binding needs and the stub had nowhere to put: each check's own `runner_identity` (the plan binds environment/runner identity per required check, not once per document) and its `observation` label, so a missing/skipped/unavailable check is an explicitly labelled failed entry instead of an unlabelled nonzero exit code. Nothing was removed or relaxed.

qualifying.description: True only for Todo 37's frozen-candidate emission; Todo 35's in-progress runs are non-qualifying observations.

observation.description: How the check was observed on its runner. Only `executed` with `exit_code` 0 is a pass; `missing`, `skipped` and `unavailable` are explicit failed entries and can never be a silent non-failure.

runner_identity.description: The environment/runner identity this individual check was observed on. A GPU/display, Docker isolation or per-platform packaged smoke is only meaningful bound to the runner that actually executed it.
